text: According to the Gospel of John, Thomas the Apostle missed one of Jesus's appearances to the Apostles after his resurrection, and said "Unless I see the nail marks in his hands and put my finger where the nails were, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe it." giving rise to the term “Doubting thomas”
bonus for identifying the painter (one of my favorites)

please do go and read about chiaroscuro technique developed by Caravaggio in the Baroque movement. it’s derived from the word oscuro, meaning darkness. he used light as a magnificent device to accentuate his subjects of the painting
